title: Receipt lines
hints: Width pads, `-` left-aligns, and `.N` sets decimals for floats or the maximum number of runes for strings: `%-12s`, `%3d`, `%7.2f`.
`Line`: `fmt.Sprintf("%-12.12s %3d x %7.2f = %8.2f", item, qty, unit, float64(qty)*unit)`. `Header` uses the same widths with `%s` verbs: `"%-12s %3s   %7s   %8s"`.
